dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: So, let's look at the scores...

dialogues.speaker: Artem
dialogues.text: I can't believe you actually beat my score... That was unreal! You're officially my hero! No, you're my new guiding light in the world of competitive darts!

dialogues.speaker: Artem
